units.source_text: 大竹七段也说：自己闹肚子，连服了三种药，还吃了预防脑贫血的药。

en.t: Otake 7-dan also said that he had an upset stomach, had taken three kinds of medicine in succession, and had also taken medicine to prevent cerebral anemia.

units.source_text: 七段过去曾在对局中晕倒，不省人事。

en.t: In the past, the 7-dan had once fainted during a match and lost consciousness.
